searchText: **AllCoreDevs in ~23h (Apr. 15, 14:00 UTC)** Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/508 Stream: https://youtu.be/JXbOeiPN_uE Zoom: to be posted before the call here I get genuinely sad when I read how people react on Twitter and Reddit on Tim Beikos comment about the merge probably won’t happen in June. I just wanted to say, you do a great job! By not rushing, ignoring the pressure to ensure a merge to PoS without major problems you do the right choice. I wish I personally could be more active and involved, but I don’t have the capacity at the moment. This world is full of "experts" who talk and doing nothing, you people make stuff happen, and that’s what counts. Keep up the good work! 🙏🏻
